scene_description: Topic ideation for campus club events, team building, commercial events, salons, competitions and online events. Produces plans that are executable within the budget, venue and prep time, creative, and safe and compliant.

questions.question: Who is the organizer? (e.g. a university anime club, company admin, class committee)
What type of event is it?
Who are the participants and how many are expected? (e.g. 30-50 current students)
How much prep time do you have?
What is the main goal of the event?
What are the venue conditions? (indoor / outdoor / online, whether confirmed, capacity)
What tone do you want for the event?
What hard constraints or taboos apply? (e.g. school approval requirements, no open flame, participant allergies or dietary restrictions)

skip_logic.description: Adjust the topic based on budget, venue, type and timeline.
rules: If the user picks "zero budget", exclude directions that need purchases or venue fees; prefer online activities, free campus spaces and items participants bring themselves
If the user picks "commercial event", switch to a formal tone and add a "business sponsorship and ROI" field to the output
If the user picks "online event" or the venue is online, exclude offline heavy-interaction games; add livestream / meeting platform options and interaction tools
If the user picks "within three days", output only light-execution plans, not multi-segment, multi-vendor complex events
If the goal is "recruiting members", the topic must include low-barrier participation and retention / conversion design; add a signup funnel note in the risk warnings

tone_examples: Good: The rules are simple enough to understand at a glance; winners get small prizes, losers do not feel awkward, even socially anxious people can join.
Good: The event has three segments, and each segment has an owner and a backup plan written out.
Bad: It is an event, we will just wing it on the day, it will be fine.
Bad: Losers have to take humiliating punishments, that is what makes it fun. (disrespectful to participants, safety risk)
conditional_notes: When the event type is "commercial event" or "wedding / celebration", switch to a formal tone and the execution document must be rigorous.
No joke or game segment may humiliate participants or create safety hazards.

constraint_list: The plan must be executable within the budget, staffing and prep time
There must be a clear event goal and a way to measure it
The participation bar must match the audience, accommodating different personalities and physical conditions
Safety and compliance: venue, fire safety, crowd density, food and electricity must follow regulations
Each plan must give the key flow, timeline milestones and owners
There must be contingency plans (weather, equipment, attendance, unexpected incidents)
exclusion_rules: Plans beyond the budget, staffing or venue conditions
Segments with safety hazards (dangerous games, open flame, food risks, etc.)
Designs involving politically sensitive, vulgar or rule-breaking content
Routine process stacking with no creativity
Single-point plans with no fallback at all
Taboos the user explicitly lists in constraints_excludes
